{{Quote|The place has been abandoned for a while now. Last residents where killed by roving Sand People or the Rebels, or the Empire. It all depends on who you talk to. But the place in mine now. I think I can turn it around and be profitable.|Zef Ando, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:LH" />}}
'''Zef Ando''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he lived as a squatter in the [[Lars homestead/Legends|Lars homestead]]<ref name="SWG:LH" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> he purchased some reconditioned [[Droid/Legends|droids]] off some [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] who visited the farm with their [[Sand Crawler 345|sandcrawler]]. However, the droids malfunctioned, attacked him and planted a bomb on a [[Moisture vaporator/Legends|moisture vaporator]]. In the meantime, spacers working for [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Arlan Barrezz|Barrezz]] as well as [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Carh'la Bastra|Bastra]] arrived at the farm since they were both looking for the Jawas. Zef Ando recruited the help of a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to stop the droids and disarm the bomb.<ref name="SWG:LH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zef Ando was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:LH" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Zef Ando was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]", a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
